scope: Static ownership documentation and source collision checks; no permissions or runtime dispatch.
semantics: Writer means the semantic admission owner of this surface, not every caller of its public API. Generic EvidenceJournal owns physical append IO; each supplied journal path has one declared semantic owner. Reader lists identify primary readers, not every transitive consumer.
corrections: Protected legacy BLD-1 eleven-field model emission and additive BOSS twelve-field deterministic projection are distinct interfaces; disposition remains required in BOSS.
Granite is required in the final build. Historical shadow names do not make it optional. Critiques and native forecasts remain producer evidence, never independent Frankie-agent findings.
Native BOSS has no knowledge store or Memory A writer. This is not a claim that the whole repository or the separate agent lineage has no memory writer.

stores.location: Caller-supplied C15Builder journal_path; never a fixed deployment path.
stores.identity: C15_FULL_EVIDENCE_V1 envelope/hash chain, source prefix, export_state/restore expected_hash.
stores.protection: Append-only complete raw/applied/failed accounting; explicit causal cursor.
stores.attribution: Source observations and deterministic C15 accounting, not agent findings.

stores.location: Derived in memory from the selected source prefix; retained in original forecast/controller artifacts.
stores.identity: ContextReceipt input/model/registry/source/packet hashes and complete selected/excluded row counts.
stores.protection: Declared recency context; no brain, knowledge or Memory A input.
stores.attribution: Deterministic native context selection; no agent authorship.

stores.identity: BOSS_ROLLING_FORECAST_V1 count/head_hash checkpoint, candidate/artifact and revision chain.
stores.protection: Single semantic writer; retained revisions and original immutable artifact bytes.
stores.attribution: B1/native decoder forecasts are producer outputs; not principal-agent calculations.

stores.protection: Durable transitions and explicit unknown-call recovery; replay never invokes providers.
stores.attribution: Native and Granite producer evidence is retained and attributed separately from Frankie agent findings.

stores.identity: BOSS_QSV_PRODUCTION_V1 checkpoint plus source/configuration/encoder hashes and per-row masks.
stores.protection: Append-only production artifacts; unavailable is not observed zero.
stores.attribution: Declared source observations plus deterministic QSV transform.

stores.location: Immutable typed plan value, durably retained by RevealLedger and PairedExperimentRunner.
stores.identity: ExperimentPlan/ArmLock/Pairing hashes; FrozenOutputs binds pre-reveal outputs.
stores.protection: Lock before execution/reveal; no extra plan journal invented.
stores.attribution: Declared experiment configuration, not empirical acceptance.

stores.protection: Reveal requires explicit authorization; append-only outcome witness.
stores.attribution: Outcome evidence stays separate from pre-reveal agent input.

stores.protection: Frozen inputs and retained outcomes; no automatic scored-history feedback into selection.
stores.attribution: Paired runner/scorer results are evaluator evidence, not agent discoveries.

stores.location: Caller-supplied ExecutionLedger path and its derived writer-lock/kill sidecars.
stores.identity: BOSS_EXECUTION_LEDGER_V1 checkpoint, wire/policy/account/observation hashes and latched kill marker.
stores.protection: Exclusive writer lease; outbox and explicit reconciliation; registry grants no order authorization.
stores.attribution: Execution policy/provider observations; no inference of trading authorization.

stores.identity: Checkpoint hash chain, stable run/controller/memory-mode/source identity.
stores.protection: Atomic checkpoint replacement; memory_mode is metadata, not memory-content write authority.

stores.location: Legacy knowledge/ng_brain.json and merge forward-test store, outside BOSS.
stores.identity: Legacy admission/register/due/settle evidence and canonical content; not a BOSS C15 checkpoint.
stores.protection: Designated admission authority is merge_gate. Historical maintenance writers exist outside BOSS and are not legitimized or executed by this map. BOSS has no writer/importer.
stores.attribution: Canonical legacy brain content remains distinct from derived cognitive records.

stores.location: Generated brain_view view/play_index, never a second canonical store.
stores.identity: Derived from canonical brain by role/phase/window view rules.
stores.protection: Derived index only; no canonical admission authority.
stores.attribution: Legacy retrieval/index projection, not newly learned findings.

stores.location: Caller-supplied MemoryRecord sets and derived working selection, outside native BOSS.
stores.identity: record_hash, selection hash, withdrawal audit and knowable_at/created_at.
stores.protection: Derived cognitive model; WRITE_CANONICAL forbidden; no BOSS knowledge input.
stores.attribution: Declared authority/source on every record; derived selection is not canonical brain admission.

stores.location: Frozen prior bundle selected for Sunday comparison; deployment/run path supplied independently.
stores.protection: Immutable comparison input; no BOSS writer. Never substitute refreshed carry containing Sunday findings.
stores.attribution: Prior memory evidence is disclosed as prior memory, never independent current-run discoveries.

stores.location: Separate pinned agent lineage seed output, selected by its own --seed argument/default.
stores.identity: Seed source-file digests, mission pin, knowledge registration/bundle/receipt hashes.
stores.protection: Agent lineage writer exists; it preserves original44 VERIFIED findings and carries separately admitted NEW findings. This does not permit modifying frozen comparison memory.
stores.attribution: Only admitted agent findings with original attribution/provenance; producer forecasts never become findings automatically.

detects: New direct EvidenceJournal constructors including import aliases and module aliases.
Append calls on file-local constructor aliases or explicit journal/_journal attributes outside listed semantic methods.
Protected knowledge/MemoryA path writes/deletes/renames using literal path fragments, path variables and simple local aliases; BOSS imports of legacy admission/cognition modules.
limitations: Static source checks, not a Python security sandbox or whole-repository single-writer proof.
Cannot resolve arbitrary dynamic paths, reflection, runtime reassignment, interprocedural aliases, subprocess IO or external code.
Dynamic journal path identity remains the callers checkpoint/lease responsibility; public owner APIs may be called by orchestrators.
Tests parse AST and read pinned external Git blobs; they never import legacy modules with top-level side effects.
